g.text: HyFormer–MerRec: compiled BF16 inference on one H100
Filled circles: A→B→E order; open squares: E→B→A. Whiskers: IQR of 10 block means, not confidence intervals.
1,000 warm-ups; 10×100 timed forwards. GPU-resident inputs; load/compile/H2D excluded. Both rounds retained.
